blocking.quote: a clean dark outline that reads at standard zoom ... not heavy black keylines
blocking.fix: Use the same thin, soft dark outline on the east profile as on the south and north views.

polish.quote: legibility at 32 px. Both are polish.
polish.fix: Give the fish a slightly bolder dark outline and stronger value contrast between the pink tumours and the olive body so it reads at 32 px.

reply.subject: RSW_MutatingTumorfishFry__MutatingTumorfish_Stage2
reply.image_seen: The montage and individual sprites show a lumpy juvenile fish: south has a head-on toothed mouth and paired fins; east shows its scaled flank, pink tumours and forked tail; north shows the back and tail end without eyes; the scale panel shows a small fish beside a human.

concerns.evidence: The east outline is narrow and varies with the anatomy: darkest around the open mouth and lower jaw, softer along the tumours and finely edged fins. It supports the painterly shading without forming a heavy continuous keyline; the south mouth has similarly dark definition.
